files.rationale: Kept PR A's tooltip prop, collapsed-state title, centering and conditional name rendering while applying PR B's dark-mode text, active and hover color classes to the outer element.

Kept PR A's responsive sidebar structure (mobile drawer, backdrop, collapse toggle, collapsed icons, tooltips) and layered PR B's dark-mode classes onto every corresponding element, including the sidebar, search input, borders, profile text, buttons and main content backgrounds, extending the same dark palette to A's new collapsed-state elements.
